system.description:
Summon Ghost: ring your Spirit Bell and summon a ghost from another world. Ask them a question from the list below per each Insight you spent.

  • How can I hurt them?

  • Who's most dangerous here?

  • What do they intend to do?

  • Where are they vulnerable?

  • What is hidden or lost here?

  • Where can I hide here?

  • What's really going on here?
